fitted_on: train + validation + test = ALL matches 2022-08-01 .. 2026-10-12 (deployment fit; the evaluation in 'evaluation' used only matches before each kick-off)
formula: For a stat S with exported block B: mu_home = exp(B.intercept + B.competitions.get(competition_id, 0) + B.home_advantage + B.teams[home].attack + B.teams[away].concede + referee_offset); mu_away = exp(B.intercept + B.competitions.get(competition_id, 0) + B.teams[away].attack + B.teams[home].concede + referee_offset); referee_offset = B.referees.get(referee, {offset: 0}).offset (only stats whose referees block is not empty; 0 for an unknown or missing referee); an unknown team contributes 0 for attack and concede. Each side is NegativeBinomial with mean mu and size B.dispersion r (variance mu + mu^2 / r), P(X > line) = 1 - P(X <= floor(line)). Team markets use one side. Total markets: if B.total_dispersion is null, the total is the exact convolution of the two NB sides (independence); otherwise the total is NB with mean mu_home + mu_away and size B.total_dispersion (this captures the home/away correlation of the counts). Team 'attack' / 'concede' already contain the dominance block (attack = A + S, concede = D - S). 'competitions' is the competition level of the CURRENT season (the model keeps a random-walk level per competition and season when level mode is on, see hyperparameters.use_level). team_recent holds plain averages of the last 5 matches (for UI display only, not model inputs).
